## Module to write
path: ServerScriptService/FeatureVerifier.server.luau
purpose: Feature: Add executable checks and fix failures for: the SHOP button opens a panel listing every Upgrades entry with price and affordability, and buying Dropper 2 for 10 works once; the rebirth altar appears at 5000 cash or when all upgrades are owned, and rebirth applies the multiplier and resets cash and upgrades; the plaza TOP TYCOONS board lists Cash and Rebirths; the tutorial arrow and banner appear after the first claim and advance on the first purchase. Mark each feature verified when its checks pass. -- Studio-only (RunService:IsStudio()) server script that runs the four feature checks in order after the first player has a claimed plot. It creates the two verify RemoteEvents in one place and does not touch the economy outside Studio. Each check is wrapped in pcall, and a check that errors counts as a failure with a reason string.

1. SHOP: asks the client probe to open the panel and report its cards. It passes if there is one card per entry in ReplicatedStorage/Upgrades, each showing a price and an affordability flag. The server then confirms Cash >= 10, teleports the character's HumanoidRootPart onto the Dropper 2 pad on the owned plot, and waits for it. It passes if Cash drops by exactly 10 once, the pad is gone, the Silver, Speed 1 and Dropper 3 pads appear, and upgrades_bought rises by exactly 1. It then stands on the pad location again and confirms there is no second deduction.
2. REBIRTH: first confirms the altar is absent at low cash with upgrades not all owned. It then sets Cash to RebirthConfig's threshold (5000) via the leaderstat and confirms the altar appears. Next it triggers rebirth through the same path a player would use (RebirthService's public API or the altar prompt or touch), and confirms the multiplier rose, Cash reset, owned upgrades reset, and the Rebirths leaderstat increased by 1. Finally it repeats the altar check with all upgrades owned and cash below 5000 (marking owned through UpgradeService's API) and confirms the altar appears. State is restored or reset afterwards.
3. BOARD: finds the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza and reads its SurfaceGui text. It passes if the headers or rows include both Cash and Rebirths and the current player's name appears with numeric values that match their leaderstats after a refresh.
4. TUTORIAL: reads the client's reported banner and arrow visibility. It expects both to be visible after the claim and not visible or advanced after the first purchase, using TutorialService's step state or the player attribute it exposes.

On pass, the verifier bumps ForgeTelemetry.count('feature_verified_<id>', 1) exactly once per feature, sets Workspace attribute FeatureVerified_<id> = true, and prints '[FeatureVerifier] <id> VERIFIED'. On failure it sets FeatureFailed_<id> to the reason string and prints it via print, not warn, so the output stays clean. It bumps no gameplay counters itself. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: feature_verified_shop, feature_verified_rebirth, feature_verified_board, feature_verified_tutorial.

# This game's style and juice (from the director; apply wherever your module touches it)
- Palette: #FF8FD0, #FF6A2B, #7FE3FF, #4CD964, #B04CFF, #F2C46B, #FFD23F, #2B2D42; materials: SmoothPlastic, Neon, Grass, Sand, Ice, Slate, Wood; lighting: Bright late-morning ClockTime 14, Brightness 2.5, a light blue Atmosphere with low haze, Bloom (intensity 0.5, threshold 1.0) and ColorCorrection with Saturation 0.15 and slightly warm tint
- Use GameAssets (ReplicatedStorage/GameAssets.luau): play(name), burst(at), shake() on the client, part(props) for every world part. Sound names: Coin, Buy, Gem, Click, Pop, Error, Whoosh, Jump, Land, Boom, Splash, Hurt, Win, Music. Director sounds: Coin->Coin, Buy->Buy, Click->Click, Pop->Pop, Error->Error, Whoosh->Whoosh, Land->Land, Win->Win, Boom->Boom, Music->Music
- Juice: cube collected: soft short Coin tick, collector flashes bright yellow, tiny sparkle at the intake, floating +$N rises over the collector; HUD cash punches and ticks up; cube dropped: none (silent so it does not spam), small puff and a squash tween on the dropper nozzle; BuyPad affordable: pad turns green and pulses with a brighter Neon glow, PriceBillboard turns green and the HUD goal bar fills; upgrade purchased: Buy confirm chime, pad pops and vanishes, the new model rises with a Back tween, a sparkle burst follows, cash counter punches, Toast 'Unlocked: Dropper 2!', small shake; not enough cash: Error buzz, pad flashes red briefly, price text shakes, Toast 'Need $X more'; ore tier upgrade (Silver/Gold/Diamond): Win sting, cubes change to the new colour with a gem-coloured shockwave ring at the dropper, RewardPopup 'GOLD ORE! $30 per cube', medium shake and brief FOV punch; shop opened: Whoosh, dim backdrop fades in, Panel scales in with a Back tween; buy buttons punch on click with a Click sound; shop purchase: Buy, button flashes green and the card's level bar fills, level x/max ticks up and cash counter punches; multiplier bought: Win, the collector glows and its multiplier sign flips to 'x2', HUD income readout flashes and gets bigger for a moment, small shake; rebirth: Boom followed by Win, white flash, confetti and gold sparkle burst, plot rebuilds with a rise tween, RewardPopup 'REBIRTH! x1.5 forever'; Rebirths stat increases, large shake and FOV punch; tutorial step complete: Pop, arrow bursts into sparkles and re-appears on the next target, Toast with the next hint; leaderboard refresh: the player's row is highlighted with a soft glow, board entries slide to their new ranks

# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull. Also keep the second purchase within about 20-30s of idle income, by raising per-item value or lowering the price, so the shop and later upgrades get exercised.
- Do not give starting cash equal to the first upgrade's price. An instant spend gives the player no chase and no sense of what cubes are for. Start slightly below the price so the first few collected cubes earn it, within about 10s.
- The first purchase must actually happen in a short playtest, and its counters (e.g. upgrades_bought) must be above 0. If the report lacks them, the first pad is too hard to find or reach. Put it close to the claimed plot's spawn point, off the walking path, and guide the player to it with a beam. Make sure the tutorial step that points to it fires.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Give failure feedback as well as success feedback. A pad or button pressed without enough cash needs a red flash, an audible buzz and a "Need $N" toast, debounced to about 1s. A silent denial confuses young players.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally. They must still be easy to find and reach: guide the player to the first pad with a visible beam or arrow.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.
- Keep the time to first core-loop activity well inside the playtest window (the probe may last only ~6-15s). Any auto-claim or auto-start fallback should fire within a few seconds (about 3-5s, not 20s), and claim gates should sit near the spawn area, not far outside the plaza. An idle player must still reach the loop quickly. Keep the spec's auto-claim delay and the tested window consistent so the plaza state can still be observed before the claim.

--!nonstrict
-- FeatureVerifier: Studio-only executable checks for SHOP, REBIRTH, BOARD and TUTORIAL.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

if not RunService:IsStudio() then
	return
end

local function safeRequire(parent: Instance, name: string): any
	local inst = parent:WaitForChild(name, 15)
	if not inst then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, m = pcall(require, inst)
	if ok then
		return m
	end
	return nil
end

local Config = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage, "FeatureChecksConfig")
local UpgradesMod = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage, "Upgrades")
local RebirthConfig = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage, "RebirthConfig")
local Telemetry = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage, "ForgeTelemetry")
local UpgradeService = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "UpgradeService")
local RebirthService = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "RebirthService")
local TutorialService = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "TutorialService")
local PlotClaimService = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "PlotClaimService")

local function cfg(key: string, default: any): any
	if type(Config) == "table" and Config[key] ~= nil then
		return Config[key]
	end
	return default
end

-- Remotes (created in one place)
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
if not remotes then
	remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
	remotes.Name = "Remotes"
	remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local function ensureRemote(name: string): RemoteEvent
	local r = remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
	if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return r
	end
	local n = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	n.Name = name
	n.Parent = remotes
	return n
end
local requestRemote = ensureRemote(cfg("requestRemote", "FeatureVerifyRequest"))
local reportRemote = ensureRemote(cfg("reportRemote", "FeatureVerifyReport"))

local pending = {}
local nextToken = 0

reportRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, kind, token, payload)
	if type(kind) ~= "string" or type(token) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	local p = pending[token]
	if not p or p.player ~= player or p.kind ~= kind or p.done then
		return
	end
	if payload ~= nil and type(payload) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	p.payload = payload or {}
	p.done = true
end)

local function waitUntil(fn: () -> any, timeout: number): boolean
	local t = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t < timeout do
		local ok, r = pcall(fn)
		if ok and r then
			return true
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	return false
end

local function askClient(player: Player, kind: string, timeout: number): any
	nextToken += 1
	local token = nextToken
	local p = { player = player, kind = kind, done = false, payload = nil }
	pending[token] = p
	requestRemote:FireClient(player, kind, token)
	waitUntil(function()
		return p.done
	end, timeout)
	pending[token] = nil
	return p.payload
end

local function tel(name: string): number
	if not Telemetry then
		return 0
	end
	local ok, t = pcall(Telemetry.get)
	if ok and type(t) == "table" then
		return tonumber(t[name]) or 0
	end
	return 0
end

local function stat(player: Player, name: string): any
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	return ls and ls:FindFirstChild(name)
end

local function upgradeList(): { any }
	local m = UpgradesMod
	if type(m) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	local l = m.list or m.all or m.upgrades
	if type(l) ~= "table" then
		l = m
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, u in ipairs(l) do
		if type(u) == "table" and u.id ~= nil then
			table.insert(out, u)
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function normName(s: string): string
	return (string.gsub(string.lower(s), "[%s_%-]", ""))
end

local function findDropper2(list)
	for _, u in ipairs(list) do
		local id, nm = normName(tostring(u.id)), normName(tostring(u.name or ""))
		if id == "dropper2" or nm == "dropper2" then
			return u
		end
	end
	for _, u in ipairs(list) do
		if u.requires == nil then
			return u
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function padInfo(upg)
	local key = normName(tostring(upg.id))
	local key2 = normName(tostring(upg.name or ""))
	local function cond(s: string): boolean
		local n = normName(s)
		if not string.find(n, "pad", 1, true) then
			return false
		end
		return string.find(n, key, 1, true) ~= nil or (key2 ~= "" and string.find(n, key2, 1, true) ~= nil)
	end
	local total, visible, first = 0, 0, nil
	for _, inst in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
			local match = inst:GetAttribute("UpgradeId") == upg.id or cond(inst.Name)
				or (inst.Parent ~= nil and inst.Parent ~= Workspace and cond(inst.Parent.Name))
			if match then
				total += 1
				if inst.Transparency < 0.95 then
					visible += 1
					first = first or inst
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return total, visible, first
end

local function teleportTo(player: Player, pos: Vector3): boolean
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
		return false
	end
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
	return true
end

local function ownedHas(player: Player, id: any): boolean
	for _, v in ipairs(UpgradeService.getOwnedIds(player)) do
		if v == id then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local tutorialAttrs = cfg("tutorialAttributes", { "TutorialStep", "TutorialDone", "TutorialStage" })
local function tutorialSnapshot(player: Player): any
	local p = askClient(player, "tutorial", 4)
	if type(p) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local steps = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(tutorialAttrs) do
		table.insert(steps, tostring(player:GetAttribute(a)))
	end
	return {
		banner = p.banner == true,
		arrow = p.arrow == true,
		text = type(p.text) == "string" and string.sub(p.text, 1, 200) or "",
		target = type(p.target) == "string" and string.sub(p.target, 1, 100) or "",
		step = table.concat(steps, "|"),
	}
end

local tutBefore, tutAfter = nil, nil

local function checkShop(player: Player)
	local list = upgradeList()
	if #list == 0 then
		return false, "Upgrades list empty"
	end
	local d2 = findDropper2(list)
	if not d2 then
		return false, "Dropper 2 upgrade not found"
	end
	local price = tonumber(d2.cost or d2.price) or 10
	tutBefore = tutorialSnapshot(player)

	local rep = askClient(player, "shop_open", 6)
	if type(rep) ~= "table" or type(rep.cards) ~= "table" then
		return false, "no shop report from client"
	end
	local cards = rep.cards
	if #cards ~= #list or #cards > 50 then
		return false, string.format("card count %d ~= upgrades %d", #cards, #list)
	end
	for i, c in ipairs(cards) do
		if type(c) ~= "table" then
			return false, "card " .. i .. " malformed"
		end
		local okPrice = type(c.price) == "number" or (type(c.price) == "string" and string.find(c.price, "%d") ~= nil)
		if not okPrice then
			return false, "card " .. i .. " has no price"
		end
		if type(c.affordable) ~= "boolean" then
			return false, "card " .. i .. " has no affordability flag"
		end
	end
	askClient(player, "shop_close", 2)

	local cash = stat(player, "Cash")
	if not cash then
		return false, "no Cash leaderstat"
	end
	if cash.Value < price then
